i0: Use ***at*** for exact **times**, ***on*** for **days and dates**, and ***in*** for **longer periods** like months, years and seasons: *at 7 pm, on Friday, in May*.
i1: This page also covers *for, during, by, until* and *within*. For *for* and *since*, see [For, Since and Ago](/blog/grammar/for-since/).
pt-at-on-in.t: At 6 o'clock, on Monday, in July
pt-at-on-in.s: ***At*** + times (*at 6 o'clock, at night*), ***on*** + days and dates (*on Monday, on 5 May*), ***in*** + months, years, seasons and parts of the day (*in July, in 2025, in the morning*).
pt-at-on-in.b0.0.0: times: *at 6 o'clock, at 7.30, at noon, at midnight*
pt-at-on-in.b0.2.1: *on Monday morning, on New Year's Day*
pt-at-on-in.b0.3.1: special days: *on Christmas Day, on my wedding day*
pt-at-on-in.b0.3.2: parts of the day: *in the morning / afternoon / evening*
pt-at-on-in.b1: American English often says ***on the weekend***; British English says ***at the weekend***. Both are correct.
pt-at-on-in.b2: Use **no preposition** before *this, next, last, every, today, tomorrow, yesterday*: *I'll see you **next** Friday.* (not *on next Friday*)
pt-special.t: On Monday morning, at night, in ten minutes, on time
pt-special.s: ***In the morning***, but ***on*** + a specific day: ***on Monday morning***. ***At night*** (in general), but ***in the night*** (during one night). ***In*** + period = after that time from now: *in ten minutes*. ***On time*** = not late; ***in time*** = early enough.
pt-special.b0.3.1: *The train leaves **in 10 minutes**.* (= 10 minutes from now)
pt-special.b0.4.1: *The bus was **on time**.* (at the planned time) / *We arrived **in time** for dinner.* (early enough)
pt-special.b1: ***On time*** = at the correct time, not late. ***In time*** = early enough for something.
pt-for-during-while.s: ***For*** + a period says **how long** (*for two hours*). ***During*** + a noun says **when**, inside a period (*during the film*). ***While*** + a clause (subject + verb): *while I was watching the film*.
pt-for-during-while.b0.2.2: *I fell asleep **while** I was watching the film.*
pt-for-during-while.b1: Don't use *during* to say how long: *I lived there **for** three years* (not *during three years*).
x.pt-at-on-in-b03: Parts of the day: *in the evening*.
x.pt-special-b06: A specific day: *on the morning of*.
